findings.desc: CHK-002:happy:0 and CHK-002:happy:1 intents require `test -f` commands confirming phase-protocol.ts and bridge-utils.ts are GONE from disk; recorded evidence for both is a static-import grep (git grep -nE from.*phase-protocol|bridge-utils) that does not cover disk-presence at all. Rule: evidence must concretely correspond to its intent. Live re-run confirms both files GONE, but the recorded evidence command is wrong for these intents.

CHK-002:happy:2 intent requires `git ls-files packages/main/src/core/phase-protocol.ts packages/main/src/verifier/bridge-utils.ts` returning empty stdout; recorded evidence is the same static-import grep, which does not test the git index. CHK-002:edge:4 and CHK-002:edge:5 intents require `git checkout HEAD -- <file>` failing with non-zero exit to prove deletion is finalized; both have the same static-import grep as evidence. Live re-runs confirm: git ls-files returns empty and both checkout attempts exit non-zero, but the recorded commands do not correspond to these intents.
